headline: Calvin carries nineteen wins into December
dek: Calvin stands as the sole MIAA3 program with an upcoming match, having taken nineteen wins and one draw against two defeats across all matches. Its defense has allowed ten goals behind an attack that has produced 67, carrying the side into a December trip to Middlebury.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring in the conference splits into a sharp top tier and a crowded middle, with Calvin's 67 goals outproducing Saint Mary's (Ind.), Adrian, and Olivet combined.

wire.line: Olivet went scoreless across eight defeats, conceding 47 goals without a win or draw.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Kalamazoo midfielder Ruby Hogan has scored nineteen goals and added eight assists on 84 shots.

findings.text: Hope goalkeeper Clara Feenstra has stopped 60 shots against thirteen goals allowed for a 0.822 save percentage.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three scheduled matches have passed their dates without a published result: Saint Mary's (Ind.) against Oberlin and Elmhurst, and Alma at Hiram.

last_match.line: Calvin had already beaten Chicago at home in September and extended its winning run away from home.

next_match.line: Calvin arrives on a winning run since its defeat to Hope and has not faced Middlebury this season.
